description: This PHP class, ClaimExpenseTypeSearchFilterParams, defines filter parameters for searching claim expense types within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for name, status, and id, with getter and setter methods, and sets a default sort field.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseTypeSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for filtering claim expense types based on name, status, and id with sorting capabilities.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the filter parameter for expense type name.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the filter parameter for expense type name.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the filter parameter for expense type status.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the filter parameter for expense type status.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the filter parameter for expense type ID.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the filter parameter for expense type ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the default sort field to 'expenseType.name'.
